question: A grandfather is five times as old as his grandson. In ten years, he will be only three times as old as his grandson would then be. If the grandfather's cousin is five years older than him, then how old was the cousin three years ago?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let grandson = x ⇒ grandfather = 5x

After 10 yrs: 5x + 10 = 3(x + 10)

⇒ 5x + 10 = 3x + 30 ⇒ 2x = 20 ⇒ x = 10

Grandfather = 5x = 50

Cousin = 50 + 5 = 55 ⇒ 3 years ago = 52

**∴ The correct answer = 52 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
